description:
List calls in summary form (no transcript). Filter by status, direction, agent, campaign, caller, engine, phone number or time window. Inbound calls and calls through an agent's mascot carry caller: who called, how they were verified, and where from. Use get_call for the full record of one call.

Requires scope `calls:read`.

caller_id.description: Only this caller's calls. See list_callers.

email.description: Matched against the email the caller gave.

ending_before.description: Cursor from a previous response. Fetches the page before it. Not with starting_after.

engine.description: Engine id as returned by list_engines.

failed_only.description: Only calls that did not connect.

location.description: Matched against the caller's city, region and country.

platform.description: Matched against the caller's browser and operating system.

search.description: Text matched against the caller's name, email, phone, city, region, country, browser, OS and device, and the numbers on the call.

source.description: Where calls came from, comma-separated: share_link, website, app, phone.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Fetches the page after it.

name: list_calls
title: List calls
